# Main Street

> Main Street is an open-source toolkit that gives a small business a professional website for about $12 a year. The owner updates it by talking to their paid AI plan (Claude Pro or ChatGPT Plus, about $20 a month): the AI prepares every change as its own pull request with a preview link, the owner checks it on their phone, and says "ship it" to make it live. No page builder, no monthly website fee, no developer on retainer, and no technical helper required for setup.

## What it is

- A **site template** (`template/`): a fast, accessible small-business website with business-type presets and plain-English owner guides.
- An **AI setup path** (`AI-SETUP.md` + `template/SETUP.md`): the owner's own AI copies the template into an empty GitHub repository and walks the owner through setup in about two hours.
- A **scaffolder** (`scripts/new-site.mjs`): for helpers who prefer a terminal, turns the template into a new site repo in one command.
- An **AI knowledge base** (`template/AGENTS.md`, the single manual every AI reads, plus `template/rules/`, `template/features/`, `template/presets/`): instructions so any capable AI can safely maintain the site.
- **Docs**: [setup guide](template/docs/setup-guide.md), [your AI](template/docs/connect-your-ai.md), [everyday examples](template/docs/examples.md), [FAQ](template/docs/faq.md), [owner page](template/README.md), [contact form key](template/docs/api-keys.md), [the $12/year stack](docs/the-12-dollar-stack.md), [for helpers](START-HERE.md), [for agencies](docs/for-agencies.md).

## Who it is for

Small business owners (florists, barbers, bakers, plumbers, salons, restaurants, shops) who want a professional website without learning a page builder or paying monthly fees, and who can set it up themselves with their own AI in about two hours. A helper (agency, freelancer, or tech-savvy friend) is optional.

## How updates work (the golden loop)

1. The owner tells their AI what they want, in plain words.
2. The AI prepares the change on its own branch and pull request, and sends the **preview link** Cloudflare builds for it.
3. The owner opens the preview link on their phone and checks it.
4. The owner says **"ship it"** and the live site updates in about a minute.

Nothing goes live without the owner seeing and approving it first.

## Key vocabulary

- **Preview link**: every change gets its own, built by Cloudflare from its pull request. There is no shared staging site. The live site is locked: GitHub blocks direct changes to `main`.
- **Ship it**: the owner's approval phrase. It means merge that pull request to production. **Undo that** means the AI reverts the change: right away if it was the most recent thing shipped, otherwise as a new preview for the owner to approve.
- **The $12/year stack**: the cost model. About $12 a year for the domain name. Hosting (Cloudflare Pages), visitor stats (Cloudflare Web Analytics), email forwarding (Cloudflare Email Routing), and contact form email (Resend) run on free tiers. The hands-free AI loop needs a paid AI plan (about $20 a month).
- **Graceful degradation**: if the contact form's one key is missing, the form steps back (visitors see an email address instead) and the page never breaks.

## Technical facts

- Static site built with Vite: plain HTML/CSS, no framework.
- Deploys on Cloudflare Pages: `main` is production, every other branch gets its own preview link. The repository is public, with a GitHub ruleset on `main` that requires a pull request.
- Contact form runs on a Cloudflare Pages Function; spam protection (Turnstile) is optional.
- MIT licensed. Repository: https://github.com/davegelinas/main-street
